briefing.geography: A south-to-north hollow of two glow bridges, one central causeway, and two middle shelves.
goals: Cross the hollow from the south launch shelf to the north extraction shelf.
rules: Two glow bridges flank one central causeway.
West and east shelves divide the middle crossing.
Waves enter from both sides of the hollow.
The north extraction stake stands beyond the causeway.

buildables.meaning: Lights the dark and slows what it touches; radius 8wu.
Timber that holds. Bandits break it before you.
Works the river for you: 3g per cycle beside water.
Holds +150 gold above the pan cap.
Spark bolts, line-of-sight, 16wu range.
Write orders; the town's craftsmen answer. One per claim.

data.sequence: enter launch shelf, enter one crossing route, reach extraction stake

data.consequence: exhausted machines are undamageable and exempt from the alive cap; capture is reached through the standing-order CAPTURE verb, not a tool

nextWave.compositionScope: wave-horn packs only; continuous tricklers are additional
